items.title: Jalen Williams + Suggs, Several Others Injured, and First Week Thoughts | Third Apron Podcast
items.body_excerpt: Jalen Williams landed on his leg awkwardly and appeared to have seriously injured his ankle. Shortly after, Jalen Suggs suffered what appeared to be a serious knee injury after his leg gave out while going up for a layup. We discuss how these teams move forward, as well as our…
